remainingFinding.contractBreach: Available owned descriptor references successfully returned by readlink are buffered locally and discarded if a later read fails; partial/error and proved-exit historical observation records then lose actual known references.
remainingFinding.observed: Actual adapter read FD7 as owned socket inode999. FD8 PermissionError led actual Session to freeze partial observed/reference socket counts0; FD8 ENOENT with proved TID exit led final zero plus historical observed socket counts0. No live proc used.
remainingFinding.qualificationImpact: Permission failures refuse runtime qualification, and final zero after proved exit remains valid. The defect is loss of mandatory partial/history evidence, not a manufactured runtime pass.
remainingFinding.requiredCorrection: Use a fixed internal finite observation handoff for each sanitized successful descriptor read, or carry bounded immutable partial descriptor observations when a later read fails. Preserve them across explicit exits, exceptions and retries. Do not add arbitrary callback/FD/path/HTTP/signal/command authority or relax deadlines/final-zero rules.
remainingFinding.title: Preserve successful descriptor reads before a later entry error or proved task exit

requirements: Retain each sanitized successful descriptor reference before later entry reads can fail, including proof of a task exit. Use a fixed internal observation handoff or bounded immutable partial exception data.
Keep available partial/reference observations through actual Session cleanup retries and detached receipt views. Unknown is never zero; physical final-zero evidence remains separate.
Preserve current task identity/two-pass/deadline requirements, sticky failure/admission, no foreign process signals, same four phases34boundaries and C/NIF/role/signalauthority bytes.
Add actual ProcMetadata low-level syscall mock and actual Session regressions for later PermissionError, proved-exit ENOENT, malformed descriptor metadata and retry retention.
Host preparation and fresh independent review only; no Linux/compiler/runtime/native/provider/Git or root tracker operations.
